## Problem / opportunity

What problem does this solve for photographers, users, contributors, or platform adapters?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the desired behavior clearly.

## Scope

- [ ] Universal Core
- [ ] Xiaoyunque adapter
- [ ] Doubao adapter
- [ ] New platform adapter
- [ ] Tooling
- [ ] Tests
- [ ] Documentation

## Why this belongs in Core or an Adapter

If proposing Core behavior, explain why it should be platform-independent.

If proposing Adapter behavior, explain which platform capability it maps to and its evidence status.

## Identity / user autonomy considerations

Could this affect identity fidelity, personal features, body representation, approval gates, or scoped revision?

## Evidence / references

Provide platform documentation, runtime observations, synthetic tests, or photography/video rationale when available.

## Acceptance criteria

What would make this feature complete and testable?
